Results.ReviewText:
The bad news is that my burners did not work properly when I got the grill. The sear feature didn’t work at all and the burners would not stay lit. The good news is that as soon as I called customer service, they immediately sent me a new gas manifold that did solve all my problems. The burners all work very well now. My only observation is that while the repair was relatively easy, some buyers may not be able to make the change of the manifold. 
So I am now very happy with the grill, but it should not have cleared final inspection at Weber.
Results.Title: Good grill after repairing

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber Spirit natural gas BBQ. It lights instantly, gets hot quickly and also does a perfect sear and the heat is super even. The cast-iron grates give great marks, cleanup is easy, and everything feels solid and well-built. Best grill upgrade I’ve made in years.
Results.Title: Enjoying my Weber Spirit Natural Gas BBQ!

Results.ReviewText: Everything I wanted and needed, and nothing I didn’t.
Results.Title: A happy customer.

Results.ReviewText: Great Weber product. Heats up quickly and always cooks delicious food.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber grill. I went with the Weber brand hoping that the burner igniters would work better than our perevious brand. So far, they work just fine. I guess time will tell. The grill seems to work as expected. I still just have to figure out some things like how long to sear meat on the searing zone. It advertises that the burner covers prevent flare-ups. Grilling burgers did cause some flare-ups, but that is the only time that happened. In general, I am very pleased with the grill.
Results.Title: Like it so far

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your experience! We are thrilled to hear that your Weber Genesis Silver C served you well for 25 years and that the Spirit E-325 has proven to be a sturdy and reliable replacement. It's great to know that the Sear Zone feature helped make your decision and the E-325 is meeting your grilling needs. We truly appreciate your loyalty to Weber and your recommendation.

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Genesis Silver C for 25 years that I won in a chili recipe. Rebuilt it after 13 years. No parts available to do that again. The E-325 has been a sturdy, reliable replacement. The sear zone feature was the deciding factor over the E-300. The E-425 is bigger, but for my needs at this time, the E-325 is the best value.
Results.Title: New Weber after 25 years

Results.ReviewText: Grill poor quality, Handle gets too hot while prewarming. Your solution was to send a mitt. Grill is just over a month old, and two of three burners not lighting. Complete waste of money. Have always bought Weber, but, no more!

Results.ReviewText: This is my fourth Webber spirit. Being that it is the fourth Weber spirit that’s going to tell you how much I like it. I wore out after about 10 years each the other three Weber spirits I cook four or five sometimes six nights a week.

Results.ReviewText: Just what I wanted. I had two trash low end grills. This one is awesome.

Results.ReviewText: We switched from a propane Spirit 3-burner to NG, and it was a good switch.  NG heats faster and burns hotter.  This grill is a little smaller than the one we had, but it still has plenty of room.  Our only issue is that the back of the grill chassis is open, so it's more difficult to keep out critters looking for a warm, dry place.  Other than that, we are happy with this grill.

Results.ReviewText: It’s so great that I think I gained weight from eating so much everything cooked on it is so delicious

Thank you for sharing your experience and for choosing the Spirit E-325. We are sorry to hear that the transition from your previous Weber Genesis has left you disappointed. Results.ReviewText: Had to replace our 16 year-old weber genesis recently and bought this spirit.  Was attracted by the smaller footprint, the folding tables, and the three burner layout.  The Spirit is nice enough, but was disappointing  in several respects.  Materials were flimsy compared to the old unit.  Where the old grill was mounted on four multi-directional casters, the Spirit has only two wheels and is much more difficult to move.  The lower storage unit is wide open in the rear, giving rain, leaves, and critters access.  Each burner must be ignited separately, rather than only once.
Results.Title: Down grade from older Weber

Results.ReviewText: My e325 works as well or better than the higher priced BBQs I’ve owned in the past.
Results.Title: The e325 is a great BBQ!

Results.ReviewText: Grill looks good and performs good. The sear feature is very nice to have.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We got the E325 Stealth model as a gift. Assembly was easy, and was purchased based on brand reputation for quality grills. Our last grill was a Weber kettle and it lasted over 25 years! Hopefully, this grill will too. I recommend getting the limited edition Stealth model as we think it looks a lot more expensive than the standard color way. Yet it was only $50 more. We highly recommend this grill and will be using it 2-3 times per week. Now if only Weber would make their propane griddles in the same Stealth model, that would make for a beautiful outdoor cook zone.
Results.Title: The Stealth model is worth the extra $$$

Results.ReviewText: We had the Spirit 2 burner for almost 10 years of faithful service and it was in such good shape we still got a good price selling it.  We bought the newest Spirit 3 burner because we wanted a little more heat and liked the sear feature and the integrated igniter system.  Really impressed and satisfied with the Weber quality design and performance.
Results.Title: Usual high quality, design and performance
